'''Force Maelstrom''', also known as '''Force Bombard''', was a devastating combination of the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[Protection bubble]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]], and [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. First, the user would form a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] Bubble around their body, concealing and protecting them inside. Then, any loose objects/persons around the user would swirl around the bubble, through telekinesis. Finally, the user would devastate the objects by blasting them away with a shock wave of energy accompanied by a surge of Force lightning.

[[Darth Malgus]] was proficient in this ability, using it to devastating effect on the unprepared enemy. Millennia later, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] mastered this ability, using it as a stepping stone to achieve mastery of the much more powerful [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]] in his later years.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Members of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's black cloaked [[Emperor's Shadow Guard|Shadow Guard]] also used this power, as did the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="TFU game">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
It was also an ability granted to a person with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] profession in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it was a cone of Force lightning generated around a Jedi that damaged all close by. Force Maelstrom was an ability featured in the Wii version of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', as well as the Duel Mode of the PSP version.
